title: Zesty Citrusy Peruvian Gobo Burdock Casserole
description: A citrusy and gooey Peruvian dish featuring gobo-burdock, perfect for a hangover cure, and a great option for a shojin-friendly meal. This wood-fired-baked casserole is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Peruvian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add sliced gobo burdock to the bowl and toss to coat with the citrus mixture.
In a separate pan, saute chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add cooked quinoa to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
In a large casserole dish, create a layer of the quinoa mixture.
Add a layer of the gobo burdock slices on top of the quinoa mixture.
Sprinkle vegan cheese shreds over the gobo burdock layer.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated wood-fired oven for 45 minutes.
